item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 20/Dec/2021
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Rai will move across the northern part of the South China Sea and continue to weaken today and tomorrow. Its associated rain bands will affect the coast of Guangdong. Temperatures over the coast of Guangdong will rise slightly in the middle and latter parts of this week. An intense winter monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China on Christmas day. The weather over the region will become appreciably colder early next week.

Date/Month: 21/12 (Tuesday)
Wind: North to northeast force 4 to 5, force 6 to 7 offshore and on high ground at first.
Weather: Cloudy with occasional rain. It will be cool. There will be swells. Rain will ease off later.
Temp range: 16 - 18 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
